components.css: .ds-filters{font-family:var(--font,"Manrope",sans-serif);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 22px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#e4d9d1);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e4d9d1);padding:18px 0;margin:28px 0;min-width:0;color:var(--ink,#422b25);line-height:1.8}.ds-filters legend{color:var(--secondary,#6c482b);font-size:14px;padding-right:12px}.ds-filters label{font-size:14px;cursor:pointer}.ds-filters input{margin-right:7px;accent-color:var(--accent,#ae2524)}.ds-filters input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#ae2524);outline-offset:4px}

components.css: .ds-features{font-family:var(--font,"Manrope",sans-serif);color:var(--ink,#422b25);margin-bottom:45px}.ds-feature{min-width:0}.ds-feature h2{font-weight:700;font-size:28px;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.025em;max-width:30ch;margin:0 0 12px;overflow-wrap:break-word;text-wrap:balance}.ds-feature h2 a{color:var(--secondary,#6c482b);text-decoration:none}.ds-feature h2 a:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--accent,#ae2524)}.ds-feature p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.8;margin:0 0 12px}.ds-feature a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#ae2524);outline-offset:4px}.ds-feature-link{font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--accent,#ae2524);text-underline-offset:.2em;text-decoration-thickness:1px}.ds-feature-link:hover{text-decoration-thickness:2px}.ds-feature .ds-feature-aside{color:var(--accent,#ae2524);font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;margin:-3px 0 15px}.ds-feature-more{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:32px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#e4d9d1);padding-top:24px;margin-top:32px}.ds-feature-more>.ds-feature:only-child{grid-column:1/-1;max-width:57ch}.ds-feature-compact h2{font-size:20px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-feature-compact p{font-size:14px}.ds-feature-compact .ds-feature-aside{font-size:13px}@media(max-width:44rem){.ds-features{margin-bottom:37px}.ds-feature h2{font-size:26px}.ds-feature-more{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:28px;margin-top:28px}.ds-feature-compact h2{font-size:20px}}

narrative.overview:
The interface uses near-white paper, warm dark text, and restrained red accents.
Manrope carries headings and body copy. Spacing, fine rules, and short annotations
establish hierarchy without decorative containers.

This document records the implemented system in `_sass/site.scss`. Source paths
are relative to the repository root. Keep the reference aligned with that
stylesheet when changing the design.
keyCharacteristics: One quiet sans-serif voice for headings and reading.
Flat paper surfaces, open features, and selective fine rules.
Red links and brief annotations, with clear keyboard focus.
Compact chronological indexes and comfortable article rhythm.

rules.name: The Red Asides Rule
rules.body: Annotations use the accent color and remain secondary to the article or project they accompany.

dos: Do preserve the flat reading layout and restrained annotation hierarchy.
Do use the shared palette and self-hosted Manrope for new site surfaces.
Do retain readable articles, native links, and visible keyboard focus.
Do use generic reference examples and preserve existing asset credits.
donts: Don't add Reader’s marks or decorative double underlines.
Don't add colors outside the palette without updating the design tokens.
Don't box the homepage feature or add ornamental shadows to this flat system.
Don't reuse About imagery as a homepage centerpiece.
